name: Maui Express
notes: 5 photos of overlapping backlit menu boards (same boards shot from different angles/distances) plus one separate 'New Combo' promo sign; merged into one list, no duplicates. Plate items show a Mini/Regular price pair; Regular is used as price with Mini noted in description. Several small side items (Bowl prices, Maui Special Plate prices, Saimin prices, Steamed Rice/Macaroni Salad/Kimchee prices) were too small and angled to read reliably and were kept with no price rather than guessed. Drink-only items (Fountain Drink, Hawaiian Sun, Bottled Water, Boba Drink, Hawaiian Shaved Ice) were skipped.
